summary: Russian forces launched a mass missile strike on Chornomorsk port infrastructure using eight missiles from Su-34, Su-30, and Su-57 aircraft. Ukrainian drone systems struck 10 tankers and 4 ferries over the past week, plus the Syzran oil refinery and a fuel train near Tokmak. Germany will finance 50,000 Shrike FPV drones with US autonomous targeting software for Ukraine.
key_points: Russian missile strike on Chornomorsk port used 6 Kh-59 and 2 Kh-31P missiles launched from 2 Su-34, 1 Su-30, and 1 Su-57 aircraft targeting port infrastructure. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/68886)
Ukrainian drone forces hit 10 tankers and 4 ferries in the past week, plus the Syzran oil refinery in Samara region and a fuel train near Tokmak, Zaporizhzhia region. (Source: @UkraineNow/82591)

Russian attack on Enerhodar bus stop killed 1 woman and wounded 4; total 11 civilians killed in Enerhodar since April 27 per local official. (Source: @tass_agency/384899, @tass_agency/384922, @tass_agency/384928)

Germany will finance purchase of 50,000 Ukrainian-made Shrike FPV drones equipped with US Auterion software for autonomous target tracking, valued at ~€90 million. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31567, @UkraineNow/82599, @tass_agency/384933)
Russian air defense claims 585 Ukrainian fixed-wing UAVs shot down in 24 hours per Russian Ministry of Defense. (Source: @tass_agency/384900)
Zelensky announced replacement of Prime Minister Sviridenko and upcoming personnel changes in government and law enforcement agencies. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31566, @UkraineNow/82597)
Poland transferred 5 Patriot missiles to Ukraine following requests from NATO Secretary General Rutte and US European Command General Grinkevich. (Source: @UkraineNow/82602)

Widespread Russian drone activity reported across Kherson, Zaporizhzhia, Dnipropetrovsk, Chernihiv, Sumy, Kharkiv, Odesa regions and Black Sea waters. (Source: @eRadarrua/100694, @kpszsu/68185, @eRadarrua/100707, @kpszsu/68220, @eRadarrua/100719)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces conducted a coordinated mass missile strike on Chornomorsk port infrastructure employing eight missiles including Kh-59 and Kh-31P variants launched from Su-34, Su-30, and Su-57 aircraft. Ukrainian unmanned systems executed a sustained campaign against Russian naval logistics, destroying 10 tankers and 4 ferries over seven days while also striking the Syzran oil refinery and a fuel train near Tokmak. Germany committed to financing 50,000 Shrike FPV drones with US autonomous targeting software, representing one of the largest Western drone procurement packages for Ukraine.

points: Ukrainian drone forces conducted a week-long campaign striking 10 Russian tankers and 4 ferries used for sanctions-evading oil transport and military logistics, plus the Syzran oil refinery in Samara region and a fuel train near Tokmak, Zaporizhzhia region. (Source: @UkraineNow/82591)

Germany will finance procurement of 50,000 Ukrainian-manufactured Shrike FPV drones equipped with US Auterion autonomous targeting software for engaging moving targets, valued at approximately €90 million. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31567, @UkraineNow/82599, @tass_agency/384933)

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces are escalating combined missile-drone operations against Ukrainian port infrastructure and energy systems, demonstrated by the coordinated Chornomorsk strike employing fifth-generation Su-57 alongside Su-34/30 platforms. Ukrainian long-range drone campaigns are systematically degrading Russian naval logistics and oil revenue streams, with 14 vessels and a major refinery struck in seven days. The German procurement of 50,000 autonomous FPV drones signals a significant leap in Ukrainian tactical drone capabilities, while Patriot missile transfers indicate sustained Western air defense commitments. Russian domestic instability signals emerge from Siberian protests over infrastructure collapse.
sections.regional_response: Germany's €90 million drone procurement package represents the largest single Western UAV commitment to date, leveraging Ukrainian manufacturing with US autonomous software. Poland's Patriot transfer, backed by NATO replenishment guarantees, demonstrates alliance cohesion on air defense. Czechia's refusal to fund Ukraine under Prime Minister Babis highlights growing European political fractures. The EU's proposed Venice Biennale funding cut over Russian participation reflects cultural-diplomatic pressure. Regional actors are calibrating support amid evolving battlefield dynamics and domestic political constraints.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian use of Su-57 in operational strike role marks a notable escalation in advanced platform employment. Ukrainian drone production capacity (SkyFall Shrike) now integrated into major Western procurement pipelines with US software integration. Russian air defense claim of 585 UAVs/day suggests intense Ukrainian drone saturation tactics. Crimea's prolonged power outage indicates persistent infrastructure vulnerability. Russian HIMARS strike claim in Kuwait appears improbable and likely disinformation. Monitoring channels report multi-axis UAV launches from Millerovo, Chauda, and Black Sea platforms indicating distributed launch architecture.
